UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Stores user profile information, including their role and status.

uid.description: The user's unique ID from Firebase Authentication.

role.description: The role assigned to the user.

status.description: The approval status of the user's account.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the user profile was created.

LedScreenProduct.title: LedScreenProduct
LedScreenProduct.description: Represents an LED screen product with its properties and pricing.

id.description: Unique identifier for the LED screen product.

name.description: Name of the LED screen product.

description.description: Detailed description of the LED screen product.

type.description: The Type of the LED screen product such as indoor/outdoor.

defaultHeight.description: Default height of the LED screen product (in meters).

defaultWidth.description: Default width of the LED screen product (in meters).

pricePerSquareMeter.description: Price per square meter of the LED screen product.

Quotation.title: Quotation
Quotation.description: Represents a quotation for an LED screen setup.

height.description: Height of the LED screen (in meters).

width.description: Width of the LED screen (in meters).

totalPrice.description: Total price of the LED screen setup.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the quotation was created.

supplierId.description: The UID of the supplier user assigned to this quote.

trackingNumber.description: The tracking number provided by the supplier.
